strict_objects: Exactly the named fields; no unknown or duplicate fields at any level. No NaN/floats/boolean integers/surrogates/BOM/trailing JSON.

cli.paths: absolute no-follow; inventory outside source/output; output absent; existing owned parent
cli.caller_anchor: --inventory-sha256 must match the actual raw companion bytes before parsing

entries.order: strict UTF-8 byte order; unique paths; regular files only

totals.directory_path_bytes: exact non-root prefix-directory UTF-8 bytes sum

cross_field_rules: Every topology file record equals its same-path entries record.
No non-root Cargo.toml basename, empty directories, symlink/hardlink/nonregular member, path-prefix collision or unknown/missing/extra member.
Input tree directories equal entry prefix closure. Source root is separate, not an entry.
Root normalized/original manifests and archive-root lock are distinct inputs, not workspace locks.
Both frozen workspace locks are mandatory; no resolver exception.
All totals are recomputed before output; all arithmetic is checked; fixed limits cannot be increased.

output.generated_bytes: byte-identical to respective original/copied template; no substitution
output.input_refused: Diagnostic only, output absent/preexisting untouched. No report claimed at absent output.
output.partial: Retain created output; no deletion/resume/build. Failed report publication leaves mapping unknown and outer collector authoritative for nonzero completion.
output.reservation_uncertainty: Any ambiguous mkdir result or success followed by inability to obtain original output authority is PARTIAL/nonzero; preserve parent/possible-entry custody, no copies and no build. No filesystem report is promised if output authority is unavailable. Known EEXIST/input rejection leaves existing output untouched.
output.no_extension: No consumer/Linux sibling, receipt, descriptor, target or unknown entry is permitted inside this sealed root. It is not moved, copied/relabelled or merged for consumer use.

output.exclusive_created: true if mkdir success was observed, null for uncertain reservation attempt; never invented

directories.order: prefix directories UTF-8 order including root as empty string only in this report

files.order: same as inventory entries; one record for every entry
files.destination_rule: copied_prefix + / + path; do not duplicate the full path string

charges.observed_peak_rss_bytes: u64-or-null; unavailable observation cannot qualify memory envelope

report_v1.error: null for COMPLETE; error-record for PARTIAL
report_v1.complete_predicate: All entries/directories/generated VERIFIED; all observed expected hashes/bytes and source revalidation match; no error; zero normal process completion; report external digest plus immediate full recheck required for build. Inventory held identity/stat and final digest match the caller anchor; output reservation is CREATED_VERIFIED with exclusive_created=true and known original identity.
report_v1.digest: External only; no self hash. Reports do not authenticate archives/backend or transfer/release custody.

terminal_diagnostic_v1.charges: Same exact charge fields as report; observed_peak_rss_bytes may be null if unavailable. Work counters start at known zero; no unknown observation is fabricated as zero.
terminal_diagnostic_v1.error: First original error-record, or null only for COMPLETE; never replace it with a later publication failure.
terminal_diagnostic_v1.publication_error: Separate REPORT_PUBLISH/CLOSE error-record or null; failed publication never claims a complete surviving map.

output_reservation_exact_fields.identity: stat-record-or-null; equal to the retained top-level output_identity

reservation_state_rules.meaning: No mkdir attempted and no existing entry established; no created output/custody claim.
Precheck found existing output or mkdir returned known EEXIST; no writes/merge/delete; identity is descriptive existing-entry evidence, not creation authority.
mkdir success and original no-follow output authority/identity were obtained; COMPLETE still requires all original completion gates.
mkdir success observed, but original output open/fstat authority not established. No file copy, no filesystem report claim, caller retains parent/entry custody.
mkdir result/partial effect uncertain. No creation/absence/original identity claim, no copy/report attempt; caller retains parent/possible-entry custody.

terminal_diagnostic_v1.reservation_consistency: Summary identity equals top-level output_identity. CREATED_UNOPENED/ATTEMPT_UNCERTAIN imply report_path=null, report_publication=NOT_CREATED, publication_error=null unless an actual separate report operation was attempted; output authority must never be invented. Original operation/stage/errno remain in error.

report_preflight: Exact reserved maximum encoding from complete map and actual escaped paths; refuse before output if over report/metadata cap; no truncation.
memory_truth: 64MiB accounted retained graph is not total RSS. 512MiB outer process allowance and actual retained/peak-RSS measurement are separate required bindings. No materializer host-limit mutation.
stability_truth: Held descriptor checks and sequential rehashes detect observed races, not atomicity or hostile concurrent same-user rewrite. Exclusive stable-source/output ownership remains a caller precondition through build.

stat_comparison_rules.source_regular_and_inventory: All eight recorded fields equal across initial/final held and path rechecks, plus bytes/hash. Atime is intentionally absent.
stat_comparison_rules.source_directories: Original held/path directory identity/kind/UID unchanged; size/nlink/mtime/ctime observations must also match because the source is stable and unwritten.
stat_comparison_rules.destination_regular: Record after completed write; all recorded fields plus bytes/hash remain unchanged through final verification and later build rechecks.
stat_comparison_rules.destination_directories_and_output_root: Verify dev/ino/mode/uid identity and exact path membership. Other fields are descriptive observations, not equality to the initially empty directory: own child/report creation legitimately changes size/nlink/mtime/ctime. Record copied-prefix directory observations after its final writes.
stat_comparison_rules.no_atomicity: Matching observations do not defeat coherent hostile same-user rewrite or unobserved ABA; exclusive custody is a caller premise.

open_rules: Held directory components: O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC. Leaf no-follow lstat first rejects nonregular, then source/inventory open O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC|O_NONBLOCK and fstat original. Destination files O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, mode0600, original held output authority. O_NONBLOCK avoids opening an observed FIFO as blocking input; unsupported concurrent same-user rebind is not a device/security guarantee.
encoding: UTF-8 strict; JSON sorted keys, ensure_ascii=false, separators comma/colon without padding, allow_nan=false, one final LF; byte ceilings include LF. Exact external SHA256 covers final bytes; no self hash.

test.output: previously absent root; terminal test-materialize-report.json plus retained per-control inputs/outputs
test.cases: Exactly C7DEL-M01..M18 plus M21/M22 in this process; M19/M20 outer Cargo and M23 authoring-map checks remain separate.

report_exact_fields.cases: Exactly20 ordered records for test_mode_ids in materializer-controls.json; same closed record/expanded literal fixture vocabulary, all required subpopulations reached.

report_exact_fields.error: closed error-record or null only for PASSED

test.exit: Zero only when all20 named in-process families and bound expanded subpopulations passed, each wrong control reached its intended assertion and fresh restored positive completed. Missing/skip/setup-only/outer termination stays INCOMPLETE. Filesystem report failure preserves nonzero outer diagnostic/custody; no fabricated publication.

verify.behavior: Independent read-only full source/map/template/generated/lock/stat/topology recheck; exact COMPLETE report anchor; no resolver, output mutation or subprocess.

diagnostic_exact_fields.error: closed error-record or null only for VERIFIED
diagnostic_exact_fields.charges: same exact charge fields as materializer report; observed_peak_rss_bytes may be null, never fake zero

verify.result: zero only for exact verified map; <=65536-byte terminal diagnostic. REFUSED nonzero; no custody release.

delivery_checker_cli.oracle_independence: Do not import materializer production validation/hash/membership routines for expected facts. Standard-library input decoding and hashlib are permitted; semantic expected maps/shape assertions are separately authored.

algorithm: Validate all12 exact options/absolute paths/anchors/closed bounded descriptor and receipt, rejecting extra/duplicate fields and unknown versions before comparisons.

Perform the existing complete strict verify of original extracted testkit, original expected inventory, original COMPLETE materialization report and original live root/subject identities. Check descriptor original source/materialized/subject identities against currently held original objects and original report; original report source/output absolute paths must equal the CLI original roots. Report metadata cannot construct or transfer ownership. Check M/C distinct direct siblings with fixed basenames and exact C three-member set.

Read approved actual consumer and Linux source roots with no-follow held descriptors; check expected source identities, full byte/member inventories and declared manifest/lock roles. Read independently created consumer/Linux copies in C and match every source/expected/receipt/destination byte/hash/identity. Never hash only receipt summaries.

Verify consumer manifest dependency paths resolve through held parent U to this exact original live M/subject-testkit and C/subject-linux, plus literal manifest semantics and own lock bytes. Refuse moved/copied/relabelled subject or foreign Linux/consumer even when file bytes match.

Recheck all roots, source/copied members, receipt and descriptor identities/digests at completion. Matching sequential observations are not atomicity/hostile same-user protection. Preserve caller exclusive ownership through later metadata/build and repeat checks immediately before/after.
Emit only one bounded diagnostic and zero for VERIFIED; otherwise REFUSED/nonzero. Write no files, run no subprocess, acquire no owner/control/lease authority and do not release custody.
verify-consumer.bounds_scope: Limits are shared over original testkit verification plus consumer/Linux/receipt checks, not reset per subcheck. Additional consumer+Linux files/bytes are jointly bounded separately from original testkit; all work/read/time/metadata/RSS limits cover the whole mode. No total RSS theorem or syscall interruption claim.

first_lock_bootstrap.unrelated_absences: Worker/driver manifests both exist in every whole-source testkit copy, but neither as-yet-uncreated unrelated own lock is required to resolve the selected own workspace. A lock generated in another independent assembly is not silently copied as a seed.

review_and_copy_order: After all three actual first locks and all six pinned-toolchain graph rows are reviewed, freeze each generated origin/hash.

Copy driver-own lock only from driver generator output into canonical driver/Cargo.lock and the exact matching driver subpath of the other source testkit assemblies.
